## Summary

Describe the user-facing problem and the chosen solution.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] UI changes include a screenshot or recording.
- [ ] User-facing changes update documentation and `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] No screenshots, fixtures, or logs contain confidential data.
- [ ] Security and local-only privacy boundaries remain intact or are explicitly discussed.

## Platform notes

List the operating systems, display scaling, and Python/Node versions tested.
